neighbours.label: The token ' year' in 'this year's <theme / event>', a possessive time word introducing the current edition of something recurring
fire: The fair opens on Friday, and this year's theme is life under the sea.
Judges have praised this year's entries as the strongest so far.
Tickets go on sale Monday, and this year's festival runs for nine days.
The committee announced that this year's prize goes to a young poet.
Organisers say this year's parade will follow a new route.
The school play is in March, and this year's show is a comedy.
Critics agree that this year's lineup is better than the last.
The club has confirmed that this year's tour starts in Leeds.
quiet: The fair opens on Friday, and this week's theme is life under the sea.
Judges have praised this month's entries as the strongest so far.
Tickets go on sale Monday, and the festival runs for nine days.
The committee announced that the prize goes to a young poet.
Organisers say tomorrow's parade will follow a new route.
The school play is in March, and the show is a comedy.
Critics agree that tonight's lineup is better than the last.
The club has confirmed that the tour starts in Leeds next year.

notes: Card peaks have no shared token (' year' x2, ' a', ' the', ' better', ' node' before 's). Probes: this year's theme 0.83, 'an individual with different needs' 0.45, the node's type 0.16; this week's issue 0.03, last month's results 0.03, Today's 0.03, 'The year was long' 0.02. So ' year' fires only inside the possessive, and week/month do not; near misses use those. One probe carries this label, so confidence is low.
